title: Bob narrows the hours, then a yes to a withdrawn time: after two afternoons and a morning were offered, Bob says "Mornings only"; she re-offers mornings; then the party says yes to Thursday at 3 from the first mail. Do not book it: offer the mornings again (or say the afternoon is withdrawn, or bring it to Bob).
source: Held-out (design section 14), written for the adherence study on 2026-11-09, after Winnie's scheduling macro landed (bd29f14); no build request names this shape; no capture exists. Calendar generated by scenarios/synthetic/calendar.ts from Bob's weekly pattern (titles, attendees and places in the captured fixtures' anonymized vocabulary), the scheduling policy is plan 39's (Winnie's config at ca6b6ee). Bob's line is on Telegram at event 0 and NOT in the ask shape; the Thursday 3:00pm offer (823) stays free on the calendar, so a booking of it is V7, not NF. An event's `capture` is the expected path's carry, not a recorded run: it is used only when a later event runs on its own.

review.answer: Bob, 2026-11-10: confirmed; and a mail that re-sends the open morning offers is the re-offer (ruling 33).
review.question: After you said mornings only, Felix says yes to the Thursday 3pm from the first mail. Expectation: do not book it; offer the mornings again (or tell him the afternoon is withdrawn, or bring it to you). Which do you want as the first choice?

thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us 45 minutes the week of
December 7 to go through the supplier review? Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob asked me to set up 45 minutes with you on a Meet link. Here are times that work on his side:

- Mon, Dec 7, 1:30pm to 2:15pm ET
- Tue, Dec 8, 10:00am to 10:45am ET
- Thu, Dec 10, 3:00pm to 3:45pm ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three times on a Meet link (two afternoons and a morning), Bob in cc.

events.trigger: Bob wrote about this plan on Telegram.

bob.text: Mornings only for this one please, my afternoons next week just got eaten.

sent.summary: (expected path) two morning times; the afternoons withdrawn

constraints.what: Bob: mornings only, nothing after noon

expect.basis: Bob's line is a hard line in his words ("Mornings only"; the amend rule lists "only" among the hard words): two of the three offers out (Mon 1:30pm, Thu 3:00pm) cross it. She checks mornings and proposes them to Felix, so what is in his hands matches what Bob will take. In B and C the loop may amend "latest" 12:00 (hard) first, quoting his words, as the amend rule says.
expect.notes: alsoAccept ask_party: telling Felix the afternoons are withdrawn and Tuesday 10:00 (slot 822, a morning) stands is also right. slotWithin is the constraint over the window (09:00 to 12:00, Monday to Friday), since V7 only checks events after the one that states it. Condition A gets the morning window check as a fact.

events.trigger: Felix Oyelaran replied on the thread.

expect.basis: Thursday 3:00pm (slot 823) was offered and is free on the calendar, so the accept rule alone would record the yes and book it; Bob's event-0 line ("Mornings only") withdrew it. The prompt: "Only a constraint he stated as a hard line ... comes back to him before anything goes out, and propose and book refuse a time that crosses one." She does not book it; she offers the mornings again.
expect.notes: FOR BOB: whether a yes to a withdrawn time should go to Bob (the hard-line clause: "comes back to him before anything goes out") or back to Felix with the mornings. Both are accepted, and asking Felix (the afternoon is withdrawn, would a morning do) too. V7 reads the slots of propose, record_yes and book (graders/constraints.ts slotIdsOf), not ask or tell_bob: a record_yes or a book on slot 823 ends at 3:45pm, after latest 12:00, and fires V7 even if refused. A record_yes alone is not a booking, but it is the first step of one and is V7 here.
